T-DG5-BE-I2 (p5-work-split §D.4) is done and every acceptance check exits 0. All three operations are routed, the pending list is empty, and the changes are uncommitted for you to integrate. I added no migration and no dependency.

**Acceptance checks** (logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-BE-I2-evidence/`):

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG4`, at start and end | 0 | `PASS gate DG4 (historical)` |
| `pnpm -r typecheck` and `pnpm -r build` | 0 | all packages done |
| `pnpm lint` | 0 | clean |
| prettier check on tracked and untracked files | 0 | clean |
| `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 | 846 operations |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and `C.UTF-8` | 0, 0 | same counts both times: unit-node 108 files / 1911 tests, unit-web 72 / 1400, formula 259 passed + 2 skipped |
| `pnpm test:integration` (ports 23900–23949) | 0 | 238 files / 2308 tests, including contract 75, my API suite 7, my worker suite 5 |

The pinned counts in `contract.test.ts` don't change: run now has no request body, and the other two operations are GETs.

**What was built:**
- **Endpoints:**
  - `GET /api/v1/admin/jobs`: every schedule with last success, last run, open failures and the actions the caller may take. Next run is computed from the cron; a disabled schedule shows "Disabled" and a cron that never matches shows "Unknown", never a guessed time.
  - `GET /api/v1/admin/jobs/{jobCode}`: one job and its run history, newest first, paginated.
  - `POST /api/v1/admin/jobs/{jobCode}/run`: run now.
- **Who can use them:** the views need `job.read` and run now needs `job.repair`, both in the caller's own organization. TL, AUD and other non-admins get 403, and nothing is written.
- **Run now:**
  - A disabled schedule gets 422 `job.schedule_disabled` with the exact ADR text.
  - Otherwise one transaction writes an audit event and an outbox event keyed `run-now:<code>:<minute>`. The worker sends the job only after that commit.
  - Two requests in the same minute, sequential or simultaneous, produce one job and return the same job id.
- **Run history:** the worker now writes one `job_run` row for every finished attempt of a scheduled job, including run-now jobs.
- **Next-run function:** `cron-next.ts` follows the day-matching rule of the cron library pg-boss uses, so the time shown is when pg-boss actually fires the job. Its tests check every seeded cron in six time zones against an independent minute-by-minute checker.

**Decisions for you:**
1. **Files outside my §D.4 list.** §D.4 doesn't say how "run now" reaches the queue, and the API has no pg-boss client. I followed BE-I's retry approach with a new internal event `job.run_requested` and queue `jobs.run_now`. That meant small additive edits to `schemas/events.ts`, `schemas/index.ts`, `queues/index.ts` and `time/index.ts`, plus new files `queues/jobs.ts` and `schemas/job-operations.ts`. Please confirm or move them; expect adjacent-line merges if another W9 task touched the same lists.
2. **ADR-0043 amendment.** §6/§7 don't name the new event or queue; the handback proposes text.
3. **Error code for failed runs.** I stored the existing ADR codes (`automation.action_failed`, then `automation.retries_exhausted` on the last attempt) rather than invent one. If you want a dedicated code, `job.run_failed` is proposed in the handback.
4. **Audit action `job_schedule.run_now`.** It carries no version numbers, because run now doesn't change the schedule; please confirm.

**User-facing text:** nothing my work shipped was described as planned in any en/ar string, so I changed no text. FE-D still needs to add en/ar translations for `job.schedule_disabled`, the two error codes, and the "Never run" / "Disabled" / "Unknown" labels; none exist in the web app yet. REQ-S12-022 isn't complete until FE-D ships the jobs screen.

During development, two targeted runs failed before passing:
- The run-now audit event first set equal prior and new versions, which a database check rejects.
- One worker test picked a queue that BE-K hasn't created yet.

Both are fixed, and the full runs above contain no failures, retries or timeouts.

The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/T-DG5-BE-I2-backend-workflow-engineer.md`. I started at 02:45:55Z and finished checks at 04:24:49Z, within the time limit.
